name: nouride-system-packages
description: System packages for a sandboxed Nouride agent: the root service nouride-pkg, its package-manager backends, and the client the engine talks to it with.
comment: A workspace member that depends on @nouride/runtime and nothing else of this repository's.
Everything that runs as root is in root/ and nowhere else, so the one part a security review
has to read can be read — or published — on its own.
What it may never decide is whether a change needs a person: that gate is packages/policy's.
